actions.description: Stop the active dashboard program through the acknowledged UR dashboard stop service; this does not command joint motion or claim a physical emergency stop
actions.name: stop_dashboard_program

outputs.description: True when the dashboard server acknowledged the stop request
outputs.name: acknowledged

facts.text: DashboardClientROS::initServices registers the private '~/stop' service and binds it to commandStopWithResponse; the accompanying comment calls it a stop of program execution.
createDashboardTriggerSrv creates a std_srvs::srv::Trigger service and maps response.ok to resp->success; an UrException sets resp->success to false.
initServices registers the private '~/program_running' service with the ur_dashboard_msgs::srv::IsProgramRunning type.
handleRunningQuery calls commandRunningWithResponse through dashboardCallWithChecks and sets resp->program_running from the acknowledged 'running' value only when resp->success is true.
dashboardCallWithChecks assigns resp->success from the dashboard response and resp->answer from its message; both exception paths set resp->success to false.
IsProgramRunning.srv declares exactly answer, program_running and success, and no request fields.
The dashboard client launch entry names the node 'dashboard_client'.
The dashboard_client_node executable creates the node with the base name 'ur_dashboard_client'.

measures.description: Read the dashboard program-running flag through the acknowledged IsProgramRunning service
measures.name: read_program_running

safe_state.description: Dashboard program execution is stopped by the acknowledged UR dashboard stop service; this is not a physical emergency stop and does not prove zero velocity or power isolation.
